fields.value: Supplementary data for "Molecular electrometer and binding of cations to phospholipid bilayers"

dsDescriptionValue.value: Collection of molecular dynamics simulation trajectories previously published in the NMRlipids community of Zenodo, and the related input files needed for their analysis. These centered (origin at the lipid bilayer center) trajectories were used in the NMRlipids II project. In addition to trajectories, files containing lipidwise C-H order parameters (for the beta and alpha segments of the PC-lipid headgroup) for each frame are provided.
